correctness.rationale: Exact absence-indicator covariance formula proved by counting. Exhaustive positive-partition recurrence through N=13, independently checked against integer-coefficient hypergeometric convolution for every profile and sample size: 369 total profiles, one two-peak profile only at N=13, with exact fractions. No infinite conclusion.

value.rationale: Rarefaction depth selection commonly uses uncertainty estimates, but a monotone or single-peak variance heuristic fails in the smallest possible census with 13 individuals. Exact witness (1,6,6) has a small-draw peak and a second six-draw peak, with a unique first-layer profile: a naturally motivated sharp invariant and useful caution for species-survey depth planning, not an arbitrary polynomial fragment.
